requirement: R23 graph-store family owned by Backend storage service
decision: STOP characterization (S21d). Graph store extraction requires the Backend factory split: initializeSqliteMemory (index.ts:21185-21189) owns the database path used by every backend store call; graph store is fixture-mode conditional (:21276-21282); makeSync is the retention connection (:20970-20974); the storage service is currently a module singleton while this service must be per-backend (runtimeStateRoot/scopeId/channel). A graph-only move would be a dual store. No product edits.
unblock: Add DAG composeBackendStorage({runtimeStateRoot,scopeId,channel,useFixtures,trackBOperationsEndpoint}) owning makeSync+initializeSqliteMemory+createTrackBFileGraphStore with one close; construct in the Backend factory; expose on BackendOwner; index consumes storage.initialization.databasePath + storage.graphStore with collision-free graph keys; migrate callers family-by-family.
